name: codex
description: Use OpenAI Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks: /codex:review, /codex:adversarial-review, /codex:rescue, /codex:transfer, plus background-job management (/codex:status, /codex:result, /codex:cancel) and an opt-in stop-time review gate. Requires Node.js 18.18+ and the Codex CLI signed in with a ChatGPT account (free tier included) or an OpenAI API key. Vendored from openai/codex-plugin-cc (Apache-2.0). Use when the user wants a second-opinion code review from Codex, wants to hand a task to Codex, or invokes /codex:*.
